title: Find the middle country or countries
description:
Find the middle country(ies) in the countries list (https://github.com/Asabeneh/30-Days-Of-Python/tree/master/data/countries.py).

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as middle_countries(countries), taking any list of country names and returning a list with the single middle item when the list has an odd length, or the two middle items when it has an even length.
hints: Whether there is one middle item or two depends on whether the list length is odd or even.
len(countries) // 2 gives the middle index for an odd-length list.
For an even-length list, slice countries[mid - 1:mid + 1] to get both middle items; otherwise return [countries[mid]].
expected_behavior: Returns the middle item (odd length) or two middle items (even length) as a list.
explanation: The same odd/even middle-index logic used for lists in general applies here: one middle index for odd lengths, a two-item slice straddling the center for even lengths.
